prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / style-transfer.
Asset: one existing installed Feudal Lord Simulator game image; non-destructive Wave41 revision.
Input1 is the immutable geometry reference. Edit this image, do not design a different asset.
Retexture the smooth clay-like hay mound into tangled dry hay fibers organized into medium-sized painterly bundles, warm straw palette, irregular fiber detail INSIDE the original boundary. No alteration to mound outline or base.
ART_BIBLE_v2: soft hand-painted prerender, muted southern English1300-1450 material palette, upper-left world lighting, no black cartoon outline, no added text/watermark.
Maintain EXACT original canvas aspect 128:128, original transparent padding, anchor/pivot, ground contact, silhouette, perspective and occupied bounds. Do not crop, recenter or rotate. Output exactly one image; no comparison sheet.
Genuine transparent background. All originally empty regions remain transparent.
Input 2 is ONLY a material brushwork reference, never a geometry reference. Preserve Input 1's exact silhouette, occupied bounds and all empty padding. Do not add the reference pole or copy its shape.

inspection.evidence: Fibrous straw now legible at native size; original per-asset mound silhouette and contact preserved. Initial smooth rim fixed by reflected generated texture extension inside original alpha.
inspection.raw_geometry: Model raw contour and branch drift are NOT claimed to pass. Final uses immutable original alpha; trees also use original non-foliage RGB.
limitations: Offline standalone review only; not installed or runtime-tested.
Reflected texture fills uncovered edge pixels; this is disclosed local texture synthesis, not geometry registration.

processing.resize: one full-canvas downsample to original dimensions; no trim, recenter, crop or rotation
processing.alpha: every original alpha byte copied exactly
processing.rgb: 88% generated RGB + 12% original RGB inside original silhouette; reflected nearest opaque generated texture extension within 16px for uncovered original edge pixels (no shape movement)
